Attached: 1 image

Every visitor to my blog was 10.42.2.1.

That's not a reader. It's the flannel gateway on one of my k3s nodes.

Fixing it meant three hops: MetalLB's externalTrafficPolicy, OpenLiteSpeed's trusted proxy list, and HAProxy. Then I tested the fix with a forged CF-Connecting-IP header and the blog logged it.

Append is not replace.

https://jonahmay.net/cloudflare-haproxy-openlitespeed-real-visitor-ip/
